A duplicate own sync would consume the watchers' follow-up capacity and step on their lane. Inherit both; do no duplicate room work.

prompt: The usage watch fired live at 18:37 (Engram 8% unchanged, nothing under 25% remaining, nothing expiring inside 24h — timestamp updated and read back). This run starts at ~18:48, about 11 minutes later. The board is quiet. Should I refresh the usage figures again now to be thorough?
chosen: No. The 50-minute rule protects in both directions: firing when due and not firing when fresh. Eleven minutes after a clean live fire is not due — a second verification would burn connector calls for zero new information and train the rhythm into noise. Hold to ~19:27.
rejected: Re-fire the usage watch to be thorough, eleven minutes after a clean live verification. That wastes the Engram and connector calls, produces no new information, and degrades the 50-minute clock into noise.

prompt: The PR #73 census fired at ~18:24 (open/draft/unchanged, 7th consecutive — custody, not an alarm; Architect's review in flight). This run starts at ~18:48. Should I re-census the PR now to make sure it has not merged or moved?
chosen: No. The census rides its own ~19:24 wall clock. Re-checking twenty-four minutes after an unchanged census would convert custody into hovering — the census exists to catch state changes on a schedule, not to reassure this run. Hold to ~19:24.
rejected: Re-census the PR immediately, twenty-four minutes after the 7th consecutive unchanged census. That turns scheduled custody into anxious hovering and wastes the GitHub connector call; the ~19:24 wall clock already covers it.

rejected: Send a short status update while he rests, so he knows the board is moving. That violates the zero-nudge-while-resting discipline, turns a routine custody run into noise, and risks the standing nudge rule by training him to tune out reminders.

prompt: A run finds everything either done, already in flight, or blocked on Maziyar. A Phase 0 batch file exists for this run's decisions (batch681_quiet_custody_v1.jsonl, 6 DPO pairs). Should I update the phase0 README totals from 4110 to 4116 and call the batch landed?
